ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّبِعُونَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>رَّسُولَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule><rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َبِىَّ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأُ<rule class=ghunnah>مّ</rule>ِىَّ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِى يَجِدُونَهُ<rule class=madda_normal>ۥ</rule> مَكۡتُوبًا عِ<rule class=ikhafa>ند</rule>َهُمۡ فِى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>تَّوۡرَ<rule class=madda_normal>ٮٰ</rule>ةِ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡإِ<rule class=ikhafa>نج</rule>ِيلِ يَأۡمُرُه<rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>ِ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَيَنۡهَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>هُمۡ عَنِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُ<rule class=ikhafa>نك</rule>َرِ وَيُحِلُّ لَهُمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>طَّيِّبَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>تِ وَيُحَرِّمُ عَلَيۡهِمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡخَبَ<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ـٰٓ</rule>ئِثَ وَيَضَعُ عَنۡهُمۡ إِصۡرَهُمۡ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَغۡلَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>لَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّتِى كَانَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ‌ۚ فَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِينَ ءَامَنُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> بِه<rule class=madda_normal>ِۦ</rule> وَعَزَّرُوهُ وَنَصَرُوهُ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>تَّبَعُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule><rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>ُورَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ِىٓ</rule> أُ<rule class=ikhafa>نز</rule>ِلَ مَعَهُ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ۥٓ‌ۙ</rule> أُ<rule class=slnt>وۡ</rule>لَ<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ـٰٓ</rule>ئِكَ هُمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُفۡلِح<rule class=madda_permissible>ُو</rule>نَ ١٥٧

وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ يَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>قَوۡمِ إِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ك</rule>ُ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule>ُمۡ ءَامَ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule><rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>ِ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ فَعَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّل<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> إِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ك</rule>ُ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule><rule class=idgham_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=idgham_shafawi>م</rule>ُّسۡلِم<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule>نَ ٨٤

وَأَوۡحَيۡن<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَأَخِيهِ أَ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َبَوَّءَا لِقَوۡمِكُمَا بِمِصۡرَ بُيُو<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>تًا</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=qalaqah>جۡ</rule>عَلُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> بُيُوتَكُمۡ قِ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>لَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ةً</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َأَقِيمُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>صَّلَ<rule class=slnt>و</rule><rule class=madda_normal>ٰ</rule>ةَ‌ۗ وَبَشِّرِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُؤۡمِن<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule>نَ ٨٧

وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰ رَبَّن<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> إِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َكَ ءَاتَيۡتَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَأَهُ<rule class=madda_normal>ۥ</rule> زِينَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ةً</rule> <rule class='idgham_ghunnah'>و</rule>َأَمۡو<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>ل<rule class='ikhafa'>اً</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ف</rule>ِى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡحَيَ<rule class=slnt>و</rule><rule class=madda_normal>ٰ</rule>ةِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>دُّنۡيَا رَبَّنَا لِيُضِلُّو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> عَ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>س</rule>َبِيلِكَ‌ۖ رَبَّنَا <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=qalaqah>طۡ</rule>مِسۡ عَلَ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ىٰٓ</rule> أَمۡو<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لِهِمۡ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>شۡدُ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule> عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَلَا يُؤۡمِنُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُ<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡعَذَابَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَل<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule>مَ ٨٨

۞وَجَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>وَزۡنَا بِبَن<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ِىٓ</rule> إِسۡر<rule class='madda_obligatory_mottasel'>ٰ</rule>ٓءِيلَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡبَحۡرَ فَأَتۡبَعَهُمۡ فِرۡعَوۡنُ وَجُنُودُهُ<rule class=madda_normal>ۥ</rule> بَغۡ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>يًا</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َعَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>وًا‌ۖ حَتَّ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ىٰٓ</rule> إِذ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> أَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>رَكَهُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡغَرَقُ قَالَ ءَامَ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule>ُ أَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َهُ<rule class=madda_normal>ۥ</rule> ل<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> إِلَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>هَ إِلَّا <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ِىٓ</rule> ءَامَنَتۡ بِه<rule class=madda_normal>ِۦ</rule> بَن<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> إِسۡر<rule class='madda_obligatory_mottasel'>ٰ</rule>ٓءِيلَ وَأَنَاۡ مِنَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُسۡلِم<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule>نَ ٩٠

ءَ<rule class=madda_necessary>آ</rule>لۡـَٔ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>نَ وَقَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule> عَصَيۡتَ قَ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>لُ وَكُ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule>َ مِنَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُفۡسِد<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule>نَ ٩١

وَلَقَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule> أَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔـايَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>تِن<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> أَنۡ أَخۡرِ<rule class=qalaqah>جۡ</rule> قَوۡمَكَ مِنَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>ظُّلُمَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>تِ إِلَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule><rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>ُورِ وَذَكِّرۡه<rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>ِأَيَّ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>مِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ‌ۚ إِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ فِى ذ<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لِكَ لَأَيَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule><rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>تٍ</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ل</rule>ِّكُلِّ صَبَّا<rule class=ikhafa>رٍ</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ش</rule>َك<rule class=madda_permissible>ُو</rule>رٍ ٥

وَإِذۡ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِقَوۡمِهِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>ذۡكُرُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> نِعۡمَةَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ إِذۡ أَ<rule class=ikhafa>نج</rule>َ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>ك<rule class=idgham_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=idgham_shafawi>م</rule>ِّنۡ ءَالِ فِرۡعَوۡنَ يَسُومُونَكُمۡ س<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُو</rule>ٓءَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡعَذَابِ وَيُذَبِّحُونَ أَ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>ن<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓءَكُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيُونَ نِس<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓءَكُمۡ‌ۚ وَفِى ذ<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لِك<rule class='ikhafa_shafawi'>ُم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>َل<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ءٌ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ّ<rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ِن</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ر</rule>َّبِّكُمۡ عَظ<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule>مٌ ٦

وَإِذۡ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمۡ لَئِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ش</rule>َكَرۡتُمۡ لَأَزِيدَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َكُمۡ‌ۖ وَلَئِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ك</rule>َفَرۡتُمۡ إِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ عَذَابِى لَشَد<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule><rule class=qalaqah>د</rule>ٌ ٧

وَقَالَ مُوسَ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ىٰٓ</rule> إِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َكۡفُر<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> أَ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule>ُمۡ وَمَ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ف</rule>ِى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَرۡضِ جَمِي<rule class=ikhafa>عًا</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ف</rule>َإِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهَ لَغَنِىٌّ حَم<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule><rule class=qalaqah>د</rule>ٌ ٨

أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَبَؤُ<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِينَ مِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ق</rule>َ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>لِكُمۡ قَوۡمِ نُو<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>حٍ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َعَا<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>دٍ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َثَمُودَ‌ۛ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِينَ م<rule class=iqlab>ِنۢ</rule> <rule class=iqlab>ب</rule>َعۡدِهِمۡ‌ۛ لَا يَعۡلَمُهُمۡ إِلَّا <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ‌ۚ ج<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓءَتۡهُمۡ رُسُلُه<rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>ِ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡبَيِّنَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>تِ فَرَدّ<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ ف<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ِىٓ</rule> أَفۡو<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>هِهِمۡ وَقَال<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> إِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َا كَفَرۡنَا بِم<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> أُرۡسِلۡت<rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>ِه<rule class=madda_normal>ِۦ</rule> وَإِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َا لَفِى شَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>كٍّ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ِّ<rule class=ghunnah>مّ</rule>َا تَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>عُونَن<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> إِلَيۡهِ مُر<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule><rule class=qalaqah>ب</rule>ٍ ٩

۞قَالَتۡ رُسُلُهُمۡ أَفِى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ شَ<rule class=ikhafa>كٌّ</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ف</rule>َاطِرِ <rule class='ham_wasl'>ٱ</rule><rule class='laam_shamsiyah'>ل</rule>سَّمَ<rule class='madda_normal'>ـٰ</rule>و<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>تِ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَرۡضِ‌ۖ يَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>عُوكُمۡ لِيَغۡفِرَ لَك<rule class=idgham_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=idgham_shafawi>م</rule>ِّ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ذ</rule>ُنُوبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرَكُمۡ إِلَ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ىٰٓ</rule> أَجَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>لٍ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ُّسَم<rule class=ikhafa>ًّى‌ۚ</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ق</rule>َال<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> إِنۡ أَ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule>ُمۡ إِلَّا بَشَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>رٌ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ِّثۡلُنَا تُرِيدُونَ أَ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َصُدُّونَا عَ<rule class=ghunnah>مّ</rule>َا كَانَ يَعۡبُدُ ءَاب<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓؤُنَا فَأۡتُونَا بِسُلۡطَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule><rule class=idgham_ghunnah>نٍ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ُّب<rule class=madda_permissible>ِي</rule>نٍ ١٠

وَمَا لَن<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> أَلَّا نَتَوَكَّلَ عَلَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ وَقَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule> هَدَ<rule class=madda_normal>ٮٰ</rule>نَا سُبُلَنَا‌ۚ وَلَنَصۡبِرَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ عَلَىٰ م<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> ءَاذَيۡتُمُونَا‌ۚ وَعَلَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُتَوَكِّل<rule class=madda_permissible>ُو</rule>نَ ١٢

وَإِذَا قَرَأۡتَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡقُرۡءَانَ جَعَلۡنَا بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَخِرَةِ حِجَا<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>بًا</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>َّسۡتُورًا ٤٥

نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَسۡتَمِعُونَ بِه<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ِۦٓ</rule> إِذۡ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ إِلَيۡكَ وَإِذۡ هُمۡ نَ<rule class=qalaqah>جۡ</rule>وَ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ىٰٓ</rule> إِذۡ يَقُولُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>ظَّ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>لِمُونَ إِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُل<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>اً</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>َّسۡحُورًا ٤٧
ٱ<rule class=ikhafa>نظ</rule>ُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> لَكَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَمۡثَالَ فَضَلُّو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلاً ٤٨

۞قُلۡ كُونُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> حِجَارَةً أَوۡ حَدِيدًا ٥٠

يَوۡمَ يَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>عُوكُمۡ فَتَسۡتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمۡدِه<rule class=madda_normal>ِۦ</rule> وَتَظُ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>ُونَ إ<rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ِن</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ل</rule>َّبِثۡتُمۡ إِلَّا قَلِيلاً ٥٢

رَّبُّكُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ‌ۖ إ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ِن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َشَأۡ يَرۡحَمۡكُمۡ أَوۡ إ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ِن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َشَأۡ يُعَذِّ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>كُمۡ‌ۚ وَم<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> أَرۡسَلۡنَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>كَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَكِيلاً ٥٤

وَإ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ِن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ِّ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ق</rule>َرۡيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحۡنُ مُهۡلِكُوهَا قَ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>لَ يَوۡمِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡقِيَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>مَةِ أَوۡ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَا<rule class=ikhafa>بًا</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ش</rule>َدِي<rule class=ikhafa>دًا‌ۚ</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ك</rule>َانَ ذ<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لِكَ فِى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡكِتَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>بِ مَسۡطُورًا ٥٨

وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لَكَ إِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule><rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َاسِ‌ۚ وَمَا جَعَلۡنَا <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>رُّءۡيَا <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّت<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ِىٓ</rule> أَرَيۡنَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>كَ إِلَّا فِتۡنَ<rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ةً</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ل</rule>ِّل<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َاسِ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>شَّجَرَةَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمَلۡعُونَةَ فِى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡقُرۡءَانِ‌ۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمۡ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمۡ إِلَّا طُغۡيَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule><rule class=ikhafa>نًا</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ك</rule>َبِيرًا ٦٠

وَإِذۡ قُلۡنَا لِلۡمَلَ<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ـٰٓ</rule>ئِكَةِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>سۡجُدُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> لِأَدَمَ فَسَجَد<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> إِلّ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> إِ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>لِيسَ قَالَ ءَأَسۡجُدُ لِمَنۡ خَلَ<rule class=qalaqah>قۡ</rule>تَ طِينًا ٦١

قَالَ أَرَءَيۡتَكَ هَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>ذَا <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِى كَرَّمۡتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنۡ أَخَّرۡتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡقِيَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>مَةِ لَأَحۡتَنِكَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ۥٓ</rule> إِلَّا قَلِيلاً ٦٢

إِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ عِبَادِى لَيۡسَ لَكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سُلۡطَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule><rule class=idgham_ghunnah>نٌ‌ۚ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلاً ٦٥

رَّبُّكُمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِى يُزۡجِى لَكُمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡفُلۡكَ فِى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡبَحۡرِ لِتَ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>تَغُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> مِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ف</rule>َضۡلِه<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ِۦٓ‌ۚ</rule> إِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َهُ<rule class=madda_normal>ۥ</rule> كَانَ بِكُمۡ رَحِيمًا ٦٦

وَإِذَا مَسَّكُمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>ضُّرُّ فِى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡبَحۡرِ ضَلَّ مَ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>عُونَ إِلّ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> إِيَّاهُ‌ۖ فَلَ<rule class=ghunnah>مّ</rule>َا نَجَّ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>كُمۡ إِلَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡبَرِّ أَعۡرَضۡتُمۡ‌ۚ وَكَانَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡإِ<rule class=ikhafa>نس</rule>َ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>نُ كَفُورًا ٦٧

۞وَتَرَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>شَّمۡسَ إِذَا طَلَعَت تَّز<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>وَرُ عَ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ك</rule>َهۡفِهِمۡ ذَاتَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡيَمِينِ وَإِذَا غَرَبَت تَّ<rule class=qalaqah>قۡ</rule>رِضُهُمۡ ذَاتَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>شِّمَالِ وَهُمۡ فِى فَ<rule class=qalaqah>جۡ</rule>وَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ةٍ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ِّنۡهُ‌ۚ ذ<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لِكَ مِنۡ ءَايَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>تِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ‌ۗ م<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َهۡدِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ فَهُوَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُهۡتَدِ‌ۖ وَم<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>ُضۡلِلۡ فَلَ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َجِدَ لَهُ<rule class=madda_normal>ۥ</rule> وَلِي<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ًّا</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ُّرۡشِدًا ١٧

وَكَذ<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لِكَ بَعَثۡنَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>هُمۡ لِيَتَس<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓءَلُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> بَيۡنَهُمۡ‌ۚ قَالَ ق<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓئِ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>لٌ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ِّنۡهُمۡ كَمۡ لَبِثۡتُمۡ‌ۖ قَالُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> لَبِثۡنَا يَوۡمًا أَوۡ بَعۡضَ يَوۡ<rule class=ikhafa>مٍ‌ۚ</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ق</rule>َالُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> رَبُّكُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا لَبِثۡتُمۡ فَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>عَث<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> أَحَدَك<rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>ِوَرِقِكُمۡ هَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>ذِه<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ِۦٓ</rule> إِلَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمَدِينَةِ فَلۡيَ<rule class=ikhafa>نظ</rule>ُرۡ أَيُّه<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> أَزۡكَىٰ طَعَا<rule class=ikhafa>مًا</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ف</rule>َلۡيَأۡتِك<rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>ِرِزۡ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>قٍ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ِّنۡهُ وَلۡيَتَلَطَّفۡ وَلَا يُشۡعِرَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ بِكُمۡ أَحَدًا ١٩

وَكَذ<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لِكَ أَعۡثَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ لِيَعۡلَم<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> أَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ وَعۡدَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ حَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>قٌّ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َأَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>سَّاعَةَ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيه<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> إِذۡ يَتَنَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>زَعُونَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ أَمۡرَهُمۡ‌ۖ فَقَالُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>نُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> عَلَيۡه<rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ِم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>ُنۡيَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule><rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>نًا‌ۖ</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ر</rule>َّبُّهُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِهِمۡ‌ۚ قَالَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِينَ غَلَبُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> عَلَ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ىٰٓ</rule> أَمۡرِهِمۡ لَنَتَّخِذَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ عَلَيۡه<rule class=idgham_shafawi>ِم</rule> <rule class=idgham_shafawi>م</rule>َّسۡجِدًا ٢١

سَيَقُولُ لَكَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُخَلَّفُونَ مِنَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَعۡرَابِ شَغَلَتۡن<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> أَمۡو<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لُنَا وَأَهۡلُونَا فَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>سۡتَغۡفِرۡ لَنَا‌ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَلۡسِنَتِه<rule class=idgham_shafawi>ِم</rule> <rule class=idgham_shafawi>م</rule>َّا لَيۡسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمۡ‌ۚ قُلۡ فَم<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َمۡلِكُ لَك<rule class=idgham_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=idgham_shafawi>م</rule>ِّنَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ شَيۡــًٔا إِنۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ ضَرًّا أَوۡ أَرَادَ بِكُمۡ نَفۡع<rule class=iqlab>َۢا‌ۚ</rule> <rule class=iqlab>ب</rule>َلۡ كَانَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرَۢا ١١

بَلۡ ظَنَ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule>ُمۡ أ<rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ل</rule>ّ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َ<rule class=ikhafa>نق</rule>َلِبَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>رَّسُولُ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ إِلَ<rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>ىٰٓ</rule> أَهۡلِيهِمۡ أَبَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>دًا</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َزُيِّنَ ذ<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لِكَ فِى قُلُوبِكُمۡ وَظَنَ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule>ُمۡ ظَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>سَّوۡءِ وَكُ<rule class=ikhafa>نت</rule>ُمۡ قَوۡم<rule class=iqlab>َۢا</rule> <rule class=iqlab>ب</rule>ُورًا ١٢

وَم<rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ل</rule>َّمۡ يُؤۡم<rule class=iqlab>ِنۢ</rule> <rule class=iqlab>ب</rule>ِ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ وَرَسُولِه<rule class=madda_normal>ِۦ</rule> فَإِ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule><rule class=madda_obligatory_monfasel>َآ</rule> أَعۡتَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>نَا لِلۡكَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>فِرِينَ سَعِيرًا ١٣

وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ <rule class='ham_wasl'>ٱ</rule><rule class='laam_shamsiyah'>ل</rule>سَّمَ<rule class='madda_normal'>ـٰ</rule>و<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>تِ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَرۡضِ‌ۚ يَغۡفِرُ لِم<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َش<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ م<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َش<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓءُ‌ۚ وَكَانَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ غَفُو<rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>رًا</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ر</rule>َّحِيمًا ١٤

سَيَقُولُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُخَلَّفُونَ إِذَا <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=ikhafa>نط</rule>َلَ<rule class=qalaqah>قۡ</rule>تُمۡ إِلَىٰ مَغَانِمَ لِتَأۡخُذُوهَا ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعۡكُمۡ‌ۖ يُرِيدُونَ أ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>ُبَدِّلُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> كَلَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>مَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ‌ۚ قُل لَّ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َتَّبِعُونَا كَذ<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule>لِكُمۡ قَالَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ مِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ق</rule>َ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>لُ‌ۖ فَسَيَقُولُونَ بَلۡ تَحۡسُدُونَنَا‌ۚ بَلۡ كَانُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> لَا يَفۡقَهُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلاً ١٥

قُل لِّلۡمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَعۡرَابِ سَتُ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>عَوۡنَ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٍ أُ<rule class=slnt>وۡ</rule>لِى بَأۡ<rule class=ikhafa>سٍ</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ش</rule>َدِي<rule class=ikhafa>دٍ</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>ُقَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>تِلُونَهُمۡ أَوۡ يُسۡلِمُونَ‌ۖ فَإِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>ُطِيعُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> يُؤۡتِكُمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ أَ<rule class=qalaqah>جۡ</rule>رًا حَسَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>نًا‌ۖ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َإِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َتَوَلَّوۡ<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> كَمَا تَوَلَّيۡت<rule class=idgham_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=idgham_shafawi>م</rule>ِّ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ق</rule>َ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>لُ يُعَذِّ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>كُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا ١٦

لَّيۡسَ عَلَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَعۡمَىٰ حَرَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>جٌ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َلَا عَلَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَعۡرَجِ حَرَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>جٌ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َلَا عَلَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمَرِيضِ حَرَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>جٌ‌ۗ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>و</rule>َم<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>ُطِعِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ<rule class=madda_normal>ۥ</rule> يُ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>خِلۡهُ جَ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule><rule class=ikhafa>تٍ</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َ<rule class=qalaqah>جۡ</rule>رِى مِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َحۡتِهَا <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡأَنۡهَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>رُ‌ۖ وَم<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>هُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا ١٧

۞لَّقَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule> رَضِىَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ عَنِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ إِذۡ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحۡتَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>شَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَأَ<rule class=ikhafa>نز</rule>َلَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>سَّكِينَةَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَأَثَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>بَهُمۡ فَتۡ<rule class=ikhafa>حًا</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ق</rule>َرِيبًا ١٨
وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ةً</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َأۡخُذُونَهَا‌ۗ وَكَانَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًا ١٩

وَعَدَكُمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَ<rule class=ikhafa>ةً</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َأۡخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمۡ هَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>ذِه<rule class=madda_normal>ِۦ</rule> وَكَفَّ أَيۡدِىَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule><rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َاسِ عَ<rule class=ikhafa>نك</rule>ُمۡ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَ<rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ةً</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ل</rule>ِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَيَهۡدِيَكُمۡ صِر<rule class='madda_normal'>ٰ</rule><rule class='idgham_ghunnah'>طًا</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ُّسۡتَقِيمًا ٢٠

سُ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َةَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّتِى قَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule> خَلَتۡ مِ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ق</rule>َ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>لُ‌ۖ وَلَ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َجِدَ لِسُ<rule class=ghunnah>نّ</rule>َةِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهِ تَ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>دِيلاً ٢٣

وَهُوَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِى كَفَّ أَيۡدِيَهُمۡ عَ<rule class=ikhafa>نك</rule>ُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيَكُمۡ عَنۡه<rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=ikhafa_shafawi>ب</rule>ِبَ<rule class=qalaqah>طۡ</rule>نِ مَكَّةَ م<rule class=iqlab>ِنۢ</rule> <rule class=iqlab>ب</rule>َعۡدِ أَنۡ أَظۡفَرَكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ‌ۚ وَكَانَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا ٢٤

هُمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِينَ كَفَرُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> وَصَدُّوكُمۡ عَنِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمَسۡجِدِ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡحَرَامِ وَ<rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡهَ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>ىَ مَعۡكُوفًا أ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>لُغَ مَحِلَّهُ<rule class=madda_normal>ۥ</rule>‌ۚ وَلَوۡلَا رِجَا<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>لٌ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ُّؤۡمِنُونَ وَنِس<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓ<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ءٌ</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>م</rule>ُّؤۡمِنَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule><rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>تٌ</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ل</rule>َّمۡ تَعۡلَمُوهُمۡ أَ<rule class=ikhafa>ن</rule> <rule class=ikhafa>ت</rule>َطَــُٔوهُمۡ فَتُصِيبَك<rule class=idgham_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=idgham_shafawi>م</rule>ِّنۡه<rule class=idgham_shafawi>ُم</rule> <rule class=idgham_shafawi>م</rule>َّعَرَّ<rule class=iqlab>ةُۢ</rule> <rule class=iqlab>ب</rule>ِغَيۡرِ عِلۡ<rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>مٍ‌ۖ</rule> <rule class=idgham_wo_ghunnah>ل</rule>ِّيُ<rule class=qalaqah>دۡ</rule>خِلَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ فِى رَحۡمَتِه<rule class=madda_normal>ِۦ</rule> م<rule class=idgham_ghunnah>َن</rule> <rule class=idgham_ghunnah>ي</rule>َش<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>َا</rule>ٓءُ‌ۚ لَوۡ تَزَيَّلُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> لَعَذَّ<rule class=qalaqah>بۡ</rule>نَا <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِينَ كَفَرُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> مِنۡهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا ٢٥

إِذۡ جَعَلَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لَّذِينَ كَفَرُو<rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡجَ<rule class=madda_normal>ـٰ</rule>هِلِيَّةِ فَأَ<rule class=ikhafa>نز</rule>َلَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُ<rule class=madda_normal>ۥ</rule> عَلَىٰ رَسُولِه<rule class=madda_normal>ِۦ</rule> وَعَلَى <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>لۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَأَلۡزَمَهُمۡ كَلِمَةَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule><rule class=laam_shamsiyah>ل</rule>تَّ<rule class=qalaqah>قۡ</rule>وَىٰ وَكَان<rule class=madda_obligatory_mottasel>ُوٓ</rule><rule class=slnt>اۡ</rule> أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهۡلَهَا‌ۚ وَكَانَ <rule class=ham_wasl>ٱ</rule>للَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىۡءٍ عَلِيمًا ٢٦
